content:
lina: Hey team — Atlas Labs wants a short POC using our hosted API. They need a scoped API key for embeddings only, IP allowlist, TTL 7 days, and a documented handoff + revoke process. Can someone create this and confirm rotation plan?

cody: Quick q — which CIDR range do they need whitelisted and do they need streaming or batch only?

lina: CIDR is 34.12.0.0/16. Batch embeddings only. They asked for no data retention on our side if possible (we'll need to confirm what that means). Also want the key to expire automatically after 7d.

dani: For POCs we recommend short-lived scoped keys + a companion rotation policy: create key with 7d TTL, rotate on day 3 if test runs long, and revoke immediately after demo. Use the console scoped key flow so the key has minimal scopes.

marc: Security notes: we need IP allowlist, audit log entry, and the handoff stored in the shared vault. I can generate the key but need the formal acceptance from Atlas (email) recorded in the ticket before we hand over. Also confirm if customer wants us to disable analytics for that key.

lina: they'll accept a short email. They asked to disable usage analytics and to not store raw payloads. Can we annotate the key with that policy?

priya: Ops side: I can create the key via internal admin tool. Steps (internal CLI):
- infractl keys create --name atlas-poc --scopes embeddings --ttl 7d --allowlist 34.12.0.0/16 --note 'Atlas Labs POC; disable analytics'
- infractl keys annotate atlas-poc --policy no_payload_retention
This will create a key id and an audit entry.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INC-3347 for atlas labs hosted key request. Assigned to priya and marc.

kai: After creation, for revocation we use the revoke endpoint. Example command for ops: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'  
Make sure we add a post-handoff checklist: rotate secrets in 1Password, update the ticket with who accepted, and update the allowlist if they change IP ranges.

lina: Can someone create the key now? Atlas is on a tight demo schedule this afternoon.

marc: I will create it in ~20m and post the handoff. Will not paste the secret in Slack; I'll put it in the shared 1Password vault and update INC-3347 with the 1Password link + customer acceptance email.

deploy-bot: INC-3347 updated: marc added 1Password link placeholder.

lina: Awesome, thanks all :thumbsup:
